1.english_reference: And the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factus est sermo Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

2.english_reference: What is the vine tree more than any tree , [ or than ] a branch which is among the trees of the forest ?

traditions.WLC: מַה יִּֽהְיֶ֥ה עֵץ הַ גֶּ֖פֶן מִ כָּל עֵ֑ץ הַ זְּמוֹרָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בַּ עֲצֵ֥י הַ יָּֽעַר
traditions.LXX: τί ἂν γένοιτο τὸ ξύλον τῆς ἀμπέλου ἐκ πάντων τῶν ξύλων τῶν ὄντων ἐν τοῖς ξύλοις τοῦ δρυμοῦ ;
traditions.VUL: quid fiet de ligno vitis , ex ómnibus lignis némorum , quæ sunt inter ligna silvárum ?
traditions.KJV: What is the vine tree more than any tree , [ or than ] a branch which is among the trees of the forest ?

3.english_reference: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ יֻקַּ֤ח מִמֶּ֨ נּוּ֙ עֵ֔ץ לַ עֲשׂ֖וֹת לִ מְלָאכָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: εἰ λήμψονται ἐξ αὐτῆς ξύλον τοῦ ποιῆσαι εἰς ἐργασίαν ;
traditions.VUL: Numquid tollétur de ea lignum ut fiat opus ,
traditions.KJV: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work ?

3.english_reference: or will [ men ] take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon ?

traditions.WLC: אִם יִקְח֤וּ מִמֶּ֨ נּוּ֙ יָתֵ֔ד לִ תְל֥וֹת עָלָ֖י ו כָּל כֶּֽלִי
traditions.LXX: εἰ λήμψονται ἐξ αὐτῆς πάσσαλον τοῦ κρεμάσαι ἐπ᾽ αὐτὸν πᾶν σκεῦος ;
traditions.VUL: aut fabricábitur de ea paxíllus , ut depéndeat in eo quodcúmque vas ?
traditions.KJV: or will [ men ] take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon ?

4.english_reference: Behold , it is cast into the fire for fuel ;

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֥ה לָ אֵ֖שׁ נִתַּ֣ן לְ אָכְלָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: Ecce igni datum est in escam :
traditions.KJV: Behold , it is cast into the fire for fuel ;

4.english_reference: the fire devoureth both the ends of it ,

traditions.WLC: אֵת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י קְצוֹתָ֜י ו אָכְלָ֤ה הָ אֵשׁ֙
traditions.LXX: τὴν κατ᾽ ἐνιαυτὸν κάθαρσιν ἀπ᾽ αὐτῆς ἀναλίσκει τὸ πῦρ ,
traditions.KJV: the fire devoureth both the ends of it ,

4.english_reference: and the midst of it is burned .

traditions.VUL: et medíetas eius redácta est in favíllam :
traditions.KJV: and the midst of it is burned .

4.english_reference: Is it meet for [ any ] work ?

traditions.KJV: Is it meet for [ any ] work ?

5.english_reference: Behold , when it was whole , it was meet for no work :

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּה֙ בִּֽ הְיוֹת֣ וֹ תָמִ֔ים לֹ֥א יֵֽעָשֶׂ֖ה לִ מְלָאכָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: οὐδὲ ἔτι αὐτοῦ ὄντος ὁλοκλήρου οὐκ ἔσται εἰς ἐργασίαν ;
traditions.VUL: Etiam cum esset íntegrum , non erat aptum ad opus :
traditions.KJV: Behold , when it was whole , it was meet for no work :

5.english_reference: how much less shall it be meet yet for [ any ] work , when the fire hath devoured it , and it is burned ?

traditions.WLC: אַ֣ף כִּי אֵ֤שׁ אֲכָלַ֨תְ הוּ֙ וַ יֵּחָ֔ר וְ נַעֲשָׂ֥ה ע֖וֹד לִ מְלָאכָֽה
traditions.LXX: μὴ ὅτι ἐὰν καὶ πῦρ αὐτὸ ἀναλώσῃ εἰς τέλος , εἰ ἔσται ἔτι εἰς ἐργασίαν ;
traditions.VUL: quanto magis cum illud ignis devoráverit , et combússerit , nihil ex eo fiet óperis ?
traditions.KJV: how much less shall it be meet yet for [ any ] work , when the fire hath devoured it , and it is burned ?

6.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ;

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο εἰπόν Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ;

6.english_reference: As the vine tree among the trees of the forest , which I have given to the fire for fuel ,

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֵץ הַ גֶּ֨פֶן֙ בְּ עֵ֣ץ הַ יַּ֔עַר אֲשֶׁר נְתַתִּ֥י ו לָ אֵ֖שׁ לְ אָכְלָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Ὃν τρόπον τὸ ξύλον τῆς ἀμπέλου ἐν τοῖς ξύλοις τοῦ δρυμοῦ ὃ δέδωκα αὐτὸ πυρὶ εἰς ἀνάλωσιν ,
traditions.VUL: Quómodo lignum vitis inter ligna silvárum , quod dedi igni ad devorándum ,
traditions.KJV: As the vine tree among the trees of the forest , which I have given to the fire for fuel ,

6.english_reference: so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem .

traditions.KJV: so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem .

7.english_reference: And I will set my face against them ;

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתִּ֤י אֶת פָּנַ י֙ בָּ הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ δώσω τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς ·
traditions.VUL: Et ponam fáciem meam in eos :
traditions.KJV: And I will set my face against them ;

7.english_reference: they shall go out from [ one ] fire , and [ another ] fire shall devour them ;

traditions.WLC: מֵ הָ אֵ֣שׁ יָצָ֔אוּ וְ הָ אֵ֖שׁ תֹּֽאכְלֵ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: ἐκ τοῦ πυρὸς ἐξελεύσονται , καὶ πῦρ αὐτοὺς καταφάγεται ,
traditions.VUL: de igne egrediéntur , et ignis consúmet eos :
traditions.KJV: they shall go out from [ one ] fire , and [ another ] fire shall devour them ;

7.english_reference: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD , when I set my face against them .

traditions.WLC: וִֽ ידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּ שׂוּמִ֥ י אֶת פָּנַ֖ י בָּ הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπιγνώσονται ὅτι ἐγὼ Κύριος ἐν τῷ στηρίσαι με τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς .
traditions.VUL: et sciétis quia ego Dóminus , cum posúero fáciem meam in eos ,
traditions.KJV: and ye shall know that I [ am ] the LORD , when I set my face against them .

8.english_reference: And I will make the land desolate ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתִּ֥י אֶת הָ אָ֖רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ δώσω τὴν γῆν εἰς ἀφανισμὸν
traditions.VUL: et dédero terram ínviam , et desolátam :
traditions.KJV: And I will make the land desolate ,

8.english_reference: because they have committed a trespass , saith the Lord GOD .

traditions.WLC: יַ֚עַן מָ֣עֲלוּ מַ֔עַל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהוִֽה
traditions.LXX: ἀνθ᾽ ὧν παρέπεσον παραπτώματι , λέγει Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: eo quod prævaricatóres extíterint , dicit Dóminus Deus .
traditions.KJV: because they have committed a trespass , saith the Lord GOD .
